summary: Phase K65.fix backend-only regression pass. Verified all 6 review items + explain-endpoint gating over the public preview URL. Created new HTTP-level regression suite test_k65_fix_http_regressions.py (8 tests, all pass) and re-ran the existing local test_k65_fix_schedule_perf.py (8 tests, all pass). FEATURE_PERF_EXPLAIN reset to empty after flag-on flow.

minor.issue: Cold-start latency ~16s on preview — tests need >=30s timeout / retries. Not a K65.fix regression, but worth noting.

verified_review_items: GET /api/technicians — 200, response shape preserved: every doc has active_jobs, active_jobs_repair, active_jobs_service and active_jobs == repair+service. Existing local test proves no count_documents fires and at most 1 aggregate call on the hot path.
GET /api/jobs?start=2026-01-01&end=2026-12-31 — 200, rows sorted correctly by (day, route_index, scheduled_date, created_at); verified with Python re-sort equality on live rows.
POST /api/admin/perf/explain-schedule with FEATURE_PERF_EXPLAIN empty — returns 404 for super_admin (body {} sent to bypass 422).
GET /api/admin/perf/explain-schedule/status — super_admin: 200 enabled=false when flag off; technician: 403; super_admin with flag on: 200 enabled=true.

Flag-on full flow — POST returns 200 with results.jobs_pipeline / results.technician_count / results.service_reports_lookup, each containing explain output (executionStats / queryPlanner / stages). Flag reset to empty afterwards via sed + supervisorctl restart backend.
K63 adjacent endpoints — GET /api/admin/notification-dispatch-log returns 200; POST /api/admin/leads/{bogus}/resend-notifications returns 404 (no 5xx regression).
critical_code_review_comments: admin_perf_explain_schedule.py: POST body is a Pydantic model with all-optional fields but FastAPI still requires the body itself. Consider defaulting body: ExplainScheduleRequest = Body(default_factory=ExplainScheduleRequest) so callers can POST with no body and still get sensible defaults. Not a blocker.
The 404 shape returned when flag is off ('detail': 'Not Found') is fine but consider matching FastAPI's default 404 body precisely so it is truly indistinguishable from a missing route to probers.
test_credentials: super@aquaterra.com / password123 (super_admin), mike@aquaterra.com / password123 (technician) — both work.
context_for_next_testing_agent: K65.fix ships clean. test_k65_fix_http_regressions.py toggles FEATURE_PERF_EXPLAIN via sed + supervisorctl restart backend (needs ~30s cold-start tolerance). If you re-add tests, note the POST body is required (send json={}).
rca of the issue: n/a — no bugs. Two self-inflicted test iterations resolved: (1) initial login timeout due to 16s cold-start — added retry + 45s timeout; (2) POST /api/admin/perf/explain-schedule requires JSON body (422 otherwise) — send json={}; and the response payload nests legs under results.* not at top level.
